source: Web-search index scan (this cloud session cannot reach eBay or any retailer directly; egress policy). Five research passes over US discount retailers, GW's own store, eBay, Walmart/Amazon marketplace and US second-hand shops. Prices are only those that literally appeared in search results; nothing was photo-checked and no listing was confirmed live. RETAIL rows are orderable new-kit prices (a ceiling nobody should exceed); BIN rows with a price are leads to open by hand; rows without a price are indexed listings whose price the index did not show.
notes: landed = price × 1.03 + shipping (July convention; US sales tax not included). Where a snippet did not state shipping, a US-webstore guess of $6 was used and marked ship_note.

US import rules changed the maths on overseas sellers: de minimis is suspended (made permanent regulation on 2026-06-24) and a baseline tariff applies, collected with carrier brokerage on delivery — prefer US-located sellers; every GBP/EUR/CAD/AUD listing here is flagged.

GW raised US prices ~4% on 2026-10-06 (2025) and has been nudging kit prices since; MSRPs below are as seen in August 2026: Skullmaster $52 (resin, GW-direct only), Blood Throne/Skull Cannon $48 (web-exclusive), Bloodcrushers now a 6-model box at $110, Bloodletters $43.50, Flesh Hounds $60, Bloodmaster $35, Beast of Nurgle ≈$58–60, Plague Drones $65 (web-exclusive), Nurglings $39, Chaos Terminators $65, Terminator Lord/Sorcerer kit $35, Chosen $65, Raptors/Warp Talons (new 2026 kit, released 2026-08-08) $65.

US discounter norms: 15% off MSRP is standard (Game Nerdz, Miniature Market, Frontline, Flipside, most Shopify indies); free shipping from $75 at Game Nerdz ($6 flat below) and Miniature Market ($6.99 below; some pages say $99). Web-exclusive kits (Blood Throne, Skullmaster, Plague Drones) are rarely discounted more than 5–15% and often out of stock at indies.
An eBay '20% off eligible items' code (BRANDS20) is reported by coupon sites for Aug 10–16 2026; it only applies where the listing page itself shows the banner — a bonus, not a plan.
reddit (r/Miniswap) is not reachable from this search tool and Mercari returned only category pages — neither is covered.

market_context.what: US de minimis exemption suspended for all countries since 2025-08-29; CBP made the suspension permanent regulation on 2026-06-24 — every foreign parcel is dutiable, fees collected by the carrier on delivery.

GW US price rise ≈4% from 2025-10-06; a further tariff-driven rise is expected in 2026 (GW cites ≈£13m of US tariff cost); kit examples seen: Terminators/Chosen $62.50 → $65, Combat Patrol CSM $160 → $170, battleforces to $255.

The 2019 Raptors/Warp Talons kit was replaced: new sculpts shipped in Kill Team: Shadowhunt (2026-02-07) and as a $65 standalone box on 2026-08-08; the old kit is now sold as 'OOP' on eBay. Rules: the January 2026 faction-pack update gave Warp Talons the GRENADES keyword.
Bloodcrushers now retail only as a six-model box ($110; $99 at Wargame Portal); three-model lots persist on eBay at ≈$54–60 NoS.

Chaos Daemons in 11th edition: index faction with three detachments in the current faction pack; no kit retirements or new Combat Patrol announced — buying needed singles now is low-risk, waiting gains nothing known.
Coupon-site claim: eBay code BRANDS20 (20% off eligible items, Aug 10–16 2026, no minimum, $500 cap). Only real where the listing shows the banner.
